feed.title: Heat Opportunities: Common Shade
feed.subtitle: Find work, research and funding opportunities to help protect people from extreme heat.

entry.title: Nexa Lighthouse: Transition to Scale funding for climate and health innovation in Asia and the Pacific (Grand Challenges Canada)
entry.summary: Grant or funding call. Direct heat relevance. Projects implemented in eligible countries in Asia and the Pacific, listed in Appendix B of the funding opportunity.. Deadline: 8 December 2026, 14:00 ET. Extreme heat is one of the hazards named in the call.

entry.title: Analyst (Consultant) - Centre of Excellence for Heat Resilience and Sustainable Cooling (CEHSC) (NRDC India)
entry.summary: Individual consultancy. Direct heat relevance. Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. The listing also asks for the ability to work based in Mumbai or Nagpur, prefers candidates based in Nagpur and in Maharashtra, and mentions about 30% travel.. Deadline: 11 December 2026 (cut-off time not published). The role supports the Maharashtra Centre of Excellence for Heat Resilience and Sustainable Cooling, with research on heat action planning and sustainable cooling.

entry.title: Senior Analyst (Consultant) - Centre of Excellence for Heat Resilience and Sustainable Cooling (CEHSC) (NRDC India)
entry.summary: Individual consultancy. Direct heat relevance. Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. The listing also asks for the ability to work based in Mumbai or Nagpur, prefers candidates based in Maharashtra and in Mumbai, and mentions about 20-30% travel.. Deadline: 11 December 2026 (cut-off time not published). The role leads research on extreme heat and health and reviews heat action plans for the Maharashtra Centre of Excellence for Heat Resilience and Sustainable Cooling.

entry.title: Open call: share traditional and cultural heat management practices (Southeast Asia) (Global Heat Health Information Network (GHHIN) Southeast Asia Hub)
entry.summary: Partnership or support call. Direct heat relevance. Southeast Asia.. Deadline: 18 December 2026 (cut-off time not published). Heat prevention and management practices are the subject of the call.

entry.title: Administrative Assistant (NRDC India)
entry.summary: Job. Heat-network organisation. New Delhi, India (hybrid; about 10% travel).. Deadline: 26 December 2026 (cut-off time not published). NRDC India works on extreme heat and cooling, but this administrative post lists no heat-specific duties; the listing says interest in climate, energy or the environment is a plus, not required.

entry.title: HGHI-Salata Burke Climate and Health Research Fellowship, 2027 to 2028 cohort (Harvard Global Health Institute)
entry.summary: Fellowship. Related to heat resilience. Harvard University; applicants need a Harvard faculty mentor whose department hosts the fellow.. Deadline: 3 January 2027, 23:59 ET. Climate and health research; heat-related health is within its scope, though the fellowship is not heat-specific.

entry.title: GCF Readiness support: proposals accepted at any time, recommended by 31 March 2027 (Green Climate Fund)
entry.summary: Partnership or support call. Related to heat resilience. Developing countries that are Parties to the UNFCCC.. Deadline: 31 March 2027 (cut-off time not published). Readiness can support adaptation planning that covers heat, where national priorities include it.

entry.title: Assistant Professor, Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine (National University of Singapore)
entry.summary: Job. Direct heat relevance. Kent Ridge Campus, Singapore.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Faculty post whose listing names heat resilience among its areas.

entry.title: Associate, India Program (CLASP)
entry.summary: Job. Heat-network organisation. New Delhi office, with time at government and private sector partners' offices.. Deadline: Until filled, as the source states. CLASP works on the efficiency of appliances including air conditioners and fans, but this role covers India's energy efficiency programmes broadly and lists no cooling- or heat-specific duties.

entry.title: Beat the Heat in Cities: expression of interest for countries and cities (Cool Coalition (UNEP))
entry.summary: Partnership or support call. Direct heat relevance. Cities worldwide, as proposed by countries and cities.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Heat action planning and urban cooling are the subject.

entry.title: Consultant Project Architect - BE for Health (SELCO Foundation)
entry.summary: Individual consultancy. Related to heat resilience. Not stated on the listing; it asks for regular field travel to rural and semi-urban project sites across states in India.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Designs healthcare buildings for underserved communities; the listing asks for assessments of thermal comfort in existing facilities, one of several building needs it names.

entry.title: Horizon Europe: integrating climate-related exposures into the human exposome (HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-ENVHLTH-02) (European Commission)
entry.summary: Grant or funding call. Related to heat resilience. Not limited to Europe for participation; funding of non-European partners depends on the country list.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Heat is a climate-related exposure; the topic is about the exposome broadly.

entry.title: IKI Small Grants: eighth call (GIZ)
entry.summary: Grant or funding call. Heat-network organisation. ODA-eligible countries.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). A local adaptation project could address heat; fit with the call's themes needs confirming.

entry.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Urban and Regional Climate Modeling (National University of Singapore)
entry.summary: Research position. Direct heat relevance. Kent Ridge Campus, Singapore.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Urban and regional climate modelling; the listing names heat-health among its concerns.

entry.title: Program Manager - Disaster & Climate Resilience (SELCO Foundation)
entry.summary: Job. Heat-network organisation. Bengaluru (SELCO Foundation headquarters), with regular travel to project areas in the Northeast, Maharashtra, Karnataka and Odisha.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). SELCO Foundation works on heat (including design for work at high temperatures), but this disaster and climate resilience role lists no heat-specific duties.

entry.title: Programme Manager, Heat Resilience & Performance Centre (2-year contract) (National University of Singapore)
entry.summary: Job. Direct heat relevance. Kent Ridge Campus, Singapore.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Manages programmes at a research centre on heat resilience and human performance.

entry.title: Research Assistant (Urban Microclimate Modeling and Graph Neural Networks) (National University of Singapore)
entry.summary: Research position. Direct heat relevance. Kent Ridge Campus, Singapore; field work in HDB precincts and test-bed sites.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Supports the UrbanHeatMap project: outdoor microclimate measurement and high-resolution temperature mapping for urban heat research in Singapore.

entry.title: Research Engineer/Assistant (Environmental and Thermal Sensing) (National University of Singapore)
entry.summary: Research position. Direct heat relevance. Kent Ridge Campus, Singapore.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Builds high-resolution urban thermal monitoring and early warning.

entry.title: Research Fellow (Urban Microclimate Modeling and Graph Neural Networks) (National University of Singapore)
entry.summary: Research position. Related to heat resilience. Singapore.. Deadline: No deadline published (not the same as rolling). Urban microclimate modelling informs where and how cities cool streets and buildings.
